import { useEffect, useRef, useState } from 'react';
import useFilesStore from '@/stores/files-store';
import { ConflictChunk, getFileIcon, GitYasConflict, statusColors } from '@/models/gityas-file';
import { invoke } from '@tauri-apps/api/core';
import { GET_MERGE_CONFLICT_BY_PATH, RESOLVE_CONFLICT } from '@/events/gityas-commands';
import { toastError } from '@/components/toast';
import { ArrowBigDown, ArrowBigUp, SaveIcon, XIcon } from 'lucide-react';
import { Button } from '@/components/ui/button';
import useMainBarStore, { SelectedMainBar } from '@/stores/main-bar-store';
import { MonacoMergeViewer, type MergeViewerScrollSync } from './monaco-merge-viewer';
import { useElementSize } from '@/hooks/use-element-size';
import {
  ChunkInfo,
  convertMergeTypeToLineOrigin,
  IEditOperation,
  IResolvedContent,
  LineOrigin,
  LineStatus,
  LineStatusNumber,
  MergeType,
  SelectedChunk
} from './types';

export const MergeViewer = () => {
  const { setSelectedMainBar } = useMainBarStore();
  const containerRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
  const { height, width } = useElementSize(containerRef);

  const { selectedFile, setSelectedFile } = useFilesStore();

  const [mergeConflict, setMergeConflict] = useState<GitYasConflict | undefined>(undefined);
  const [resolvedContent, setResolvedContent] = useState<IResolvedContent | undefined>(undefined);
  const [output, setOutput] = useState<string>(undefined);

  const [conflictIndex, setConflictIndex] = useState<number>(1);
  const [scrollSync, setScrollSync] = useState<MergeViewerScrollSync | undefined>(undefined);
  const scrollSyncVersionRef = useRef(0);

  useEffect(() => {
    setMergeConflict(undefined);
    invoke<GitYasConflict>(GET_MERGE_CONFLICT_BY_PATH, { path: selectedFile.file_path })
      .then((mergeConflict) => {
        console.log(mergeConflict);
        setMergeConflict(mergeConflict);
      })
      .catch((e) => {
        toastError(e);
        console.log(e);
      });
  }, [selectedFile]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (mergeConflict) {
      setResolvedContent({
        lineStatus: getAncestorLineStatus(mergeConflict.ancestor.split('\n')),
        deletes: [],
        adds: []
      });
      setOutput(mergeConflict.ancestor);
    }
  }, [mergeConflict]);

  const resetConflict = () => {
    const mc = mergeConflict;
    setMergeConflict(undefined);
    setTimeout(() => setMergeConflict(mc), 20);
  };

  const onResolveConflict = async () => {
    await invoke(RESOLVE_CONFLICT, { path: selectedFile.file_path, resolvedContent: output })
      .then(() => {
        setSelectedFile(undefined);
      })
      .catch((e) => {
        toastError(<p>{e}</p>);
      });
  };

  const handleScrollSync = (nextScrollSync: MergeViewerScrollSync) => {
    scrollSyncVersionRef.current++;
    setScrollSync({ ...nextScrollSync, version: scrollSyncVersionRef.current });
  };

  const handleLineToggle = (
    chunkIndex: number,
    line: number,
    mergeType: MergeType,
    isChecked: boolean,
    modelValue: string,
    lineStatus: LineStatus[]
  ) => {
    const newChunk: SelectedChunk = {
      chunkIndex,
      mergeType,
      lineNumber: line
    };
    updateAncestorContent(chunkIndex, mergeType, isChecked, modelValue, [newChunk], lineStatus);
  };

  const handleChunkToggle = (
    chunkIndex: number,
    mergeType: MergeType,
    isChecked: boolean,
    modelValue: string,
    lineStatus: LineStatus[]
  ) => {
    const ranges = getChunkLinesByMergeType(mergeConflict.chunks[chunkIndex], mergeType);
    const newChunks: SelectedChunk[] = ranges.map((lineNumber) => {
      const chunk: SelectedChunk = {
        chunkIndex,
        mergeType,
        lineNumber
      };
      return chunk;
    });
    updateAncestorContent(chunkIndex, mergeType, isChecked, modelValue, newChunks, lineStatus);
  };

  const updateAncestorContent = (
    chunkIndex: number,
    mergeType: MergeType,
    isChecked: boolean,
    modelValue: string,
    selections: SelectedChunk[],
    lineStatus: LineStatus[]
  ) => {
    if (!mergeConflict) return;

    let newStatuses: LineStatus[] = [...lineStatus];
    let deletes: IEditOperation[] = [];
    let adds: IEditOperation[] = [];

    const status = convertMergeTypeToLineOrigin(mergeType);
    const lines = getAllChunkIndexLines(chunkIndex, lineStatus);
    const isOneSelection = selections.length === 1;
    const linesByStatus = lines
      .filter(
        (ls) =>
          ls.status === status &&
          //For toggling lines
          (isOneSelection ? ls.chunkInfo?.get(chunkIndex)?.chunkLine === selections[0].lineNumber : true)
      )
      .sort((a, b) => a.lineNumber - b.lineNumber);

    deletes = getDeleteEdits(linesByStatus);
    applyEditsOnLineStatuses(deletes, newStatuses);

    //Add ancestor back if needed by comparing if we removed all chunk index lines
    if (lines.length === linesByStatus.length) {
      addBackAncestorChunk(chunkIndex, deletes, newStatuses);
    }

    //Add chunk index lines for that merge type if checked
    if (isChecked) {
      const index = findLastChunkIndex(chunkIndex, newStatuses);
      const linesToReplace = getLinesToReplace(index, chunkIndex, newStatuses);
      const isReplacingChunk = linesToReplace > 0;

      const startIndexArr = index - Math.max(0, linesToReplace - 1);
      const startLine = startIndexArr + 1;
      const endLine = startIndexArr + 1 + Math.max(0, linesToReplace - 1);

      const { newLineStatuses, newText } = getAddTextAndStatuses(chunkIndex, mergeType, selections, modelValue);

      newStatuses.splice(isReplacingChunk ? startIndexArr : startLine, linesToReplace, ...newLineStatuses);
      adds.push({
        startLine: startLine,
        endLine: endLine,
        text: newText.join('\n'),
        isReplacingChunk: isReplacingChunk
      });
    }

    setResolvedContent({ lineStatus: newStatuses, deletes: deletes, adds: adds });
  };

  const applyEditsOnLineStatuses = (edits: IEditOperation[], newStatuses: LineStatus[]) => {
    for (let i = edits.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
      const edit = edits[i];
      newStatuses.splice(edit.startLine - 1, edit.endLine - edit.startLine + 1);
    }
  };

  const getAddTextAndStatuses = (
    chunkIndex: number,
    mergeType: MergeType,
    selections: SelectedChunk[],
    modelValue: string
  ) => {
    let newText: string[] = [];
    let newLineStatuses: LineStatus[] = [];

    let lo: LineOrigin = LineOrigin.MODIFIED;
    if (mergeType === MergeType.OURS) lo = LineOrigin.OURS;
    if (mergeType === MergeType.THEIRS) lo = LineOrigin.THEIRS;
    selections.forEach((selection) => {
      const ci: Map<number, ChunkInfo> = new Map<number, ChunkInfo>();
      ci.set(chunkIndex, { mergeType: mergeType, chunkLine: selection.lineNumber });
      newLineStatuses.push({ status: lo, chunkInfo: ci });
    });

    let content = modelValue.split('\n');
    if (mergeType === MergeType.OURS) content = mergeConflict.ours.split('\n');
    if (mergeType === MergeType.THEIRS) content = mergeConflict.theirs.split('\n');
    selections.forEach((selection) => {
      const newLine = content[selection.lineNumber - 1];
      newText.push(newLine);
    });

    return { newText, newLineStatuses };
  };

  const getDeleteEdits = (lines: LineStatusNumber[]): IEditOperation[] => {
    if (lines.length === 0) return [];

    let edits: IEditOperation[] = [];
    let startLine = lines[0].lineNumber;
    let prevLine = lines[0].lineNumber;

    for (let i = 1; i <= lines.length; i++) {
      const curr = lines[i]?.lineNumber;
      const isNeighbour = curr === prevLine + 1;

      if (!isNeighbour || i === lines.length) {
        // Push current group
        edits.push({
          startLine,
          endLine: prevLine,
          text: null,
          isDeletingLine: true
        });

        // Start a new group if there are more lines
        if (curr !== undefined) {
          startLine = curr;
          prevLine = curr;
        }
      } else {
        prevLine = curr!;
      }
    }

    return edits;
  };

  const addBackAncestorChunk = (chunkIndex: number, deletes: IEditOperation[], newStatuses: LineStatus[]) => {
    // Grab the ancestor chunk text from mergeConflict
    const chunk = mergeConflict.chunks[chunkIndex];
    const ancestorLines = mergeConflict.ancestor.split('\n');
    const chunkLines = ancestorLines.slice(chunk.ancestor_start, chunk.ancestor_end);
    deletes[0].text = chunkLines.join('\n');
    deletes[0].isDeletingLine = false;
    deletes[0].isReplacingChunk = true;

    // Build line statuses for each restored line
    const restoredStatuses: LineStatus[] = chunkLines.map((line, idx) => {
      const ci = new Map<number, ChunkInfo>([
        [chunkIndex, { mergeType: MergeType.ANCESTOR, chunkLine: chunk.ancestor_start + idx + 1 }]
      ]);
      return { status: LineOrigin.ANCESTOR, chunkInfo: ci };
    });

    // Insert those statuses back into the lineStatus array
    newStatuses.splice(deletes[0].startLine - 1, 0, ...restoredStatuses);
  };

  const getAllChunkIndexLines = (
    chunkIndex: number,
    lineStatus: LineStatus[],
    lineOrigin?: LineOrigin
  ): LineStatusNumber[] => {
    let lineStatusNums: LineStatusNumber[] = [];
    lineStatus.forEach((ls, index) => {
      if (!ls.chunkInfo || !ls.chunkInfo.has(chunkIndex)) return;
      if (lineOrigin && ls.status !== lineOrigin) return;

      lineStatusNums.push({ ...ls, lineNumber: index + 1 });
    });

    return lineStatusNums;
  };

  const getChunkLinesByMergeType = (chunk: ConflictChunk, mergeType: MergeType) => {
    const range = (startBoundary: number, endBoundary: number) =>
      startBoundary >= endBoundary
        ? [-startBoundary]
        : Array.from({ length: endBoundary - startBoundary }, (_, i) => startBoundary + i + 1);

    switch (mergeType) {
      case MergeType.OURS:
        return range(chunk.ours_start, chunk.ours_end);
      case MergeType.THEIRS:
        return range(chunk.theirs_start, chunk.theirs_end);
      case MergeType.ANCESTOR:
        return range(chunk.ancestor_start, chunk.ancestor_end);
      default:
        return [];
    }
  };

  const getAncestorLineStatus = (ancestorLines: string[]) => {
    let newStatuses: LineStatus[] = Array.from({ length: ancestorLines.length }, (data, idx) => ({
      status: LineOrigin.ORIGINAL
    }));
    mergeConflict.chunks.forEach((chunk, index) => {
      const ranges = getChunkLinesByMergeType(chunk, MergeType.ANCESTOR);
      ranges.forEach((lineNumber) => {
        const chunkInfo = new Map<number, ChunkInfo>([[index, { mergeType: MergeType.ANCESTOR }]]);
        newStatuses[lineNumber - 1] = {
          status: LineOrigin.ANCESTOR,
          chunkInfo: chunkInfo
        };
      });
    });
    return newStatuses;
  };

  const findLastChunkIndex = (chunkIndex: number, lineStatuses: LineStatus[]) => {
    for (let i = lineStatuses.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
      const ls = lineStatuses[i];
      if (ls.chunkInfo && (ls.chunkInfo.has(chunkIndex) || [...ls.chunkInfo.keys()].some((k) => k < chunkIndex)))
        return i;
    }

    return 0;
  };

  const getLinesToReplace = (index: number, chunkIndex: number, newStatuses: LineStatus[]) => {
    let startIndex = index;
    while (
      index >= 0 &&
      newStatuses[index].status === LineOrigin.ANCESTOR &&
      newStatuses[index].chunkInfo?.has(chunkIndex)
    )
      index--;

    return startIndex - index;
  };

  const onClose = () => {
    setSelectedFile(undefined);
    setSelectedMainBar(SelectedMainBar.COMMITS);
  };

  return (
    <div className="flex flex-col w-full h-full overflow-hidden">
      {/* HEADER */}
      <div className="flex items-center p-2 bg-primary/5 border border-b-0 rounded-sm font-mono text-sm select-none">
        {/* ICON CHANGE TYPE */}
        <div className="me-1">{getFileIcon(selectedFile.change_type)}</div>

        <div className="flex w-full truncate me-2">
          {/* DIRECTORY PATH */}
          <div title={selectedFile.file_path} className="truncate text-primary/50">
            {selectedFile.directory}
          </div>

          {/* FILE NAME */}
          <div className="font-bold whitespace-nowrap" title={selectedFile.file_path}>
            {selectedFile.file_name}
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* SAVE OUTPUT BUTTON */}
        <div>
          <Button
            onClick={() => onResolveConflict()}
            title="Save conflicted changes"
            className={`mx-2 px-12 h-[26px] rounded-none text-primary bg-lime-300 hover:bg-lime-300/70 dark:bg-lime-600 dark:hover:bg-lime-600/70`}>
            <div className="flex justify-center items-center gap-1">
              <p className="text-xs">Save Output</p>
              <SaveIcon className="w-4 h-4 text-primary/25" />
            </div>
          </Button>
        </div>

        {/* CHANGE TYPE BADGE */}
        <div
          className={`${statusColors[selectedFile.change_type]?.bg} text-xs ms-auto mx-2 font-bold text-primary px-1`}>
          {selectedFile.change_type}
        </div>

        {/* EXIT BUTTON */}
        <div className="flex my-auto">
          <Button size="icon" className="w-5 h-5 rounded-xl" title="Close" onClick={onClose}>
            <XIcon className="w-4 h-4" />
          </Button>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* MERGE CONFICT VIEW */}
      <div className="flex flex-col h-full grow min-h-0" ref={containerRef}>
        <div className="flex h-full">
          <div className="grow">
            <MonacoMergeViewer
              conflict={mergeConflict}
              selectedFile={selectedFile}
              mergeType={MergeType.OURS}
              height={height / 2 - 12}
              width={width / 2}
              showCheckboxes
              onChunkToggle={handleChunkToggle}
              handleLineToggle={handleLineToggle}
              resolvedContent={resolvedContent}
              setResolvedContent={setResolvedContent}
              conflictIndex={conflictIndex}
              scrollSync={scrollSync}
              onScrollSync={handleScrollSync}
            />
          </div>

          <div className="grow">
            <MonacoMergeViewer
              conflict={mergeConflict}
              selectedFile={selectedFile}
              mergeType={MergeType.THEIRS}
              height={height / 2 - 12}
              width={width / 2}
              showCheckboxes
              onChunkToggle={handleChunkToggle}
              handleLineToggle={handleLineToggle}
              resolvedContent={resolvedContent}
              setResolvedContent={setResolvedContent}
              conflictIndex={conflictIndex}
              scrollSync={scrollSync}
              onScrollSync={handleScrollSync}
            />
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* CENTER ACTION BUTTONS */}
        <div className="flex justify-center h-[24px] w-full gap-2 relative">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-1">
            <Button
              size="icon"
              className="w-5 h-[24px] rounded-none"
              disabled={conflictIndex <= 1}
              onClick={() => setConflictIndex(conflictIndex - 1)}>
              <ArrowBigUp className="w-4 h-4" />
            </Button>
            <p className="monospace text-xs select-none">
              <strong>{conflictIndex}</strong> / <strong>{mergeConflict?.chunks.length}</strong>
            </p>
            <Button
              size="icon"
              className="w-5 h-[24px] rounded-none"
              disabled={conflictIndex >= mergeConflict?.chunks.length}
              onClick={() => setConflictIndex(conflictIndex + 1)}>
              <ArrowBigDown className="w-4 h-4" />
            </Button>
          </div>
          <div className="h-[22px] absolute right-0">
            <Button className="h-full rounded-none" onClick={() => resetConflict()}>
              Reset
            </Button>
          </div>
        </div>

        <div className="grow h-full">
          {resolvedContent !== undefined && (
            <MonacoMergeViewer
              conflict={mergeConflict}
              selectedFile={selectedFile}
              mergeType={MergeType.ANCESTOR}
              height={height / 2 - 12}
              width={width}
              resolvedContent={resolvedContent}
              setResolvedContent={setResolvedContent}
              conflictIndex={conflictIndex}
              setOutput={setOutput}
              scrollSync={scrollSync}
              onScrollSync={handleScrollSync}
            />
          )}
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
};

export default MergeViewer;
